CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.read_company_registered_allowance_labels(p_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select company_common_allowance_private.registered_labels(p_company_id)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION company_checkout_allowance_private.registered_item(cid uuid, wid uuid, item jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare answer jsonb; typ text;
begin
 if jsonb_typeof(item) is distinct from 'object' or (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(item))<>6
 or not item?&array['origin','id','generation','registration_version','name_snapshot','unit']
 or coalesce(item->>'origin','') not in ('company_legacy','company_common')
 or coalesce(item->>'id','')!~'^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
 or jsonb_typeof(item->'registration_version') is distinct from 'number'
 or coalesce(item->>'registration_version','')!~'^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,14})$'
 or jsonb_typeof(item->'name_snapshot') is distinct from 'string'
 or nullif(trim(item->>'name_snapshot'),'') is null or length(item->>'name_snapshot')>4096
 or item->>'name_snapshot'~E'[\n\r]'
 or coalesce(item->>'unit','') not in ('day','hour') then
  raise exception 'invalid company allowance selection' using errcode='22023';end if;
 select s.pay_type into typ from public.worker_payroll_settings s join public.workers w
 on w.company_id=s.company_id and w.id=s.worker_id where s.company_id=cid and s.worker_id=wid;
 if typ is null then raise exception 'worker payroll scope unavailable' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if item->>'origin'='company_legacy' then
  if jsonb_typeof(item->'generation') is distinct from 'number'
   or coalesce(item->>'generation','')!~'^[1-9][0-9]{0,14}$' or item->>'unit'<>'day'
   or (item->>'registration_version')::bigint<1
   then raise exception 'legacy selection identity unavailable' using errcode='22023';end if;
  select jsonb_build_object('origin','company_legacy','id',i.id,'generation',i.generation,
    'registration_version',s.version,'legacy_slot',i.slot,'name',to_jsonb(r)->>('allowance_'||i.slot||'_name'),
    'section','earning','unit','day','display_unit',to_jsonb(r)->>('allowance_'||i.slot||'_unit'),
    'rate_yen',(to_jsonb(r)->>('allowance_'||i.slot||'_amount_yen'))::integer)
   into answer from company_allowance_identity_private.identities i
   join company_allowance_identity_private.state s on s.company_id=i.company_id
   join public.company_rate_settings r on r.company_id=i.company_id
   where i.company_id=cid and i.id=(item->>'id')::uuid and i.retired_at is null
    and i.generation=(item->>'generation')::bigint and s.version=(item->>'registration_version')::bigint;
 else
  if item->'generation' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb then raise exception 'common generation must be null' using errcode='22023';end if;
  select jsonb_build_object('origin','company_common','id',i.id,'generation',null,
    'registration_version',s.version,'payroll_type',i.payroll_type,'name',i.name,
    'section',i.section,'unit',i.unit,'display_unit',i.unit,'rate_yen',i.amount_yen)
   into answer from company_common_allowance_private.items i
   join company_common_allowance_private.state s on s.company_id=i.company_id
   where i.company_id=cid and i.id=(item->>'id')::uuid and i.retired_at is null
    and i.payroll_type=typ and s.version=(item->>'registration_version')::bigint;
 end if;
 if answer is null or answer->>'name' is distinct from item->>'name_snapshot'
 or answer->>'unit' is distinct from item->>'unit'
 or coalesce(answer->>'section','') not in ('earning','deduction')
 or jsonb_typeof(answer->'rate_yen') is distinct from 'number'
 or (answer->>'rate_yen')::numeric<0 or (answer->>'rate_yen')::numeric>2147483647 then
  raise exception 'company allowance registration changed; reload report choices' using errcode='40001';end if;
 return answer;
end $function$
